claims.claim: Canada's Code requires every card network operator to publish its standard interchange rates and acquirer network assessment fees on its website.
claims.quote: PCNOs must make all applicable standard interchange rates, wholesale discount rates, and acquiring network assessment fees easily available on their websites.
claims.title: Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: The Code requires at least 120 days' notice to acquirers of non-structural domestic fee changes, and 210 days for structural ones.
claims.quote: PCNOs will provide at least 120 calendar days’ notice to Acquirers for domestic Non-Structural Fees changes
claims.title: Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: The RBA expects roadmaps to plan on-demand billing reports that show scheme fees against each transaction and the fees incurred by each merchant.
claims.quote: provide on-demand billing reports enabling participants to: understand the scheme fees that have been charged against each transaction
claims.title: 4. Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper
claims.label: Verified
claims.fetch: curl, 2026-09-25. Next item: 'provide timely and accurate pricing of fees that have been incurred by each merchant'.
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: Some payment service providers told the RBA they absorb scheme fee errors, because checking opaque and often revised fees costs more than the errors.
claims.quote: because scheme fees are opaque, complex and frequently revised, it is more cost-effective to absorb any resulting fee inaccuracies
claims.title: 4. Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: Some designated networks told the RBA that fee explanation duties would give exempt alternatives, including three-party card networks, an unfair advantage.
claims.quote: stated the PSB’s proposals would lead to unfair competitive advantages for these alternative services
claims.title: 4. Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper
claims.label: Verified
claims.fetch: curl, 2026-09-25. The alternatives named include three-party card networks.
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: The RBA warns that too much information about a competitor's pricing can raise prices among a few networks.
claims.quote: too much information about a competitor’s pricing strategy may result in upward price coordination.
claims.title: Transparency of Wholesale Fees, Conclusions Paper
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: The RBA found no compelling evidence that publishing aggregate scheme fee data would materially raise coordination risk, and it chose to publish.
claims.quote: The PSB did not receive compelling evidence that publishing these data would materially increase the risk of upward price coordination.
claims.title: Transparency of Wholesale Fees, Conclusions Paper
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: Canada's Code requires each fee change notice to acquirers to carry full specifications and the previous and new amounts.
claims.quote: include complete technical specifications and information, including the previous and new amount(s)
claims.title: Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: The RBA expects networks to circulate notices giving reasons for fee changes and their expected outcomes for participants.
claims.quote: provide greater contextual justification for fee changes (such as links to service quality improvements or the provision of new services) and expected outcomes for participants
claims.title: 4. Scheme Fees, Conclusions Paper
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: US rules oblige an operator of a credit card system to take risk-based steps before authorising, or keeping, an issuer or acquirer.
claims.quote: the operator does not authorize, or maintain authorization for, any person to serve as an issuing or acquiring institution without the operator taking appropriate steps
claims.title: 31 CFR 1028.210 Anti-money laundering programs for operators of credit card systems
claims.publisher: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (FinCEN rule)
claims.label: Verified
claims.fetch: curl of the eCFR renderer API, 2026-09-25
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: Part 1028 defines its subject by the operator's own credit card, so debit-only networks and developer API access fall outside the duty.
claims.quote: operates a system for clearing and settling transactions in which the operator's credit card, whether acting as a credit or debit card, is used
claims.title: 31 CFR 1028.100 Definitions
claims.publisher: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (FinCEN rule)
claims.label: Verified
claims.fetch: curl of the eCFR renderer API, 2026-09-25
claims.note: Added by the insight work (pressure-test), accessed 2026-09-25.

claims.quote: However, the incident highlighted issues with Visa’s communications during the outage.
claims.title: CP19/2 Draft Specific Direction 9: Crisis Communications (Visa)
claims.label: Verified
